Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[6]_{9}?$

- $-12$
- $3$
- $24$

current_example.problem:
Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[5]_{8}?$

- $-3$

- $13$

- $3$
current_example.worked_solution:
The residue class $[5]_{8}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $5$ modulo $8.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[5]_{8} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡5\,(\text{mod}\,8)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x=5+8k,\,k\in Z} \\  & ={5+8k\,|\,k\in Z} \\  & ={…,\,5-2\cdot 8,\,5-8,\,5,\,5+8,\,5+2\cdot 8,\,…} \\  & ={…,-11,-3,5,13,21,…}.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that $-3$ and $13$ belong to $[5]_{8},$ while $3$ does not.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and II only."
